name: Large Pack
description: A frame pack that carries more than a person should.

name: Lockpicks
description: A roll of picks and tension wrenches, mostly intact.

name: Flashlight
description: A heavy flashlight with a weak beam and a spare battery.

name: Toolkit
description: A mechanics' toolkit in a steel case. The tools outlive the vehicles.

name: Radio
description: A handheld radio, patched into a frequency that still has voices on it.

name: Handcuffs
description: A pair of steel handcuffs with the key on a wire.

name: Batteries
description: Four batteries of mixed sizes, still holding a charge.

name: Solar Panel
description: A folding solar panel. Heavy, fragile, and worth a winter.

name: Radio Parts
description: Coils, wire, and a cracked transceiver that still works.

name: Laptop
description: A sealed laptop with a working battery. The data may be worth more than the machine.

name: Data Drive
description: A drive with a label someone thought was important.

name: Repair Manual
description: A workshop manual for an engine you may never find.

name: Cook Pot
description: A steel pot with a lid. Boils water, cooks food, and makes noise.

name: Barricade
description: A braced panel of scrap and timber, ready to set against a door or gate.

name: Rope
description: Thirty feet of climbing rope, worn but sound.

name: Lighter
description: A windproof lighter with fluid left in it.

name: Water Filter
description: A hand-pump filter that makes bad water drinkable.

name: Clean Cloth
description: Boiled and folded cloth for bandages and clean work.

name: Lab Chemicals
description: A crate of reagents, solvents, and things with warning labels.

name: Ward Charm
description: A salt-and-candle ward bound to a threshold for a scene.

name: Duct Tape
description: A roll of tape that holds the world together for one more day.
